findings.issue: `arensMul_inclusionInDoubleDual_left` and `arensMul_inclusionInDoubleDual_right` (line 110) prove agreement of the two orders by unfolding the definitions for `ContinuousLinearMap.mul` only. Their proofs duplicate each other and hold for any bounded bilinear map.

findings.evidence: The two proofs have the same structure (`ext`; `congr 1`; `ext`; `simp [hT]`) and differ only by `flip`. `hT` is used only as an intertwining identity for the bilinear map `mul`.
findings.fix: Add a general lemma to Bilinear.lean: if `S`, `T`, `U` are bounded linear maps with `U (B x y) = B' (S x) (T y)`, then `precomp (precomp U) (B.arensExtension X Y) = B'.arensExtension (precomp (precomp S) X) (precomp (precomp T) Y)`. Get both algebra lemmas from it, applying it to `mul` and to `mul.flip`.
findings.issue: `precomp_precomp_arensMul` and `precomp_precomp_arensMulRev` (line 211) repeat one naturality argument for multiplication only, although the PR already has the general `arensExtension` layer where this naturality can be proved once.

summary: The general bilinear layer (`bilinearTranspose`, `arensExtension`, norm bounds, weak-star continuity) sits at the right level, but the agreement and functoriality results are proved ad hoc for multiplication, each twice, instead of once for bounded bilinear maps.
